A: Turn 2 says the unpaid developer-founder, who works full-time elsewhere, 'counts as the second team member, part-time' and that the only thing stopping them is the full-time rule. The Business Finland Sprint Q&A (BFRK/9/910/2026) says the minimum is one full-time person plus a second full-time equivalent, which several part-timers may share, so one spare-time founder does not fill the second slot.
